objective: Recuperar y certificar en modo estrictamente READ_ONLY la arquitectura canónica ya diseñada de EDARSAHUB GLOBAL HCM + PAYROLL + COMPLIANCE + RECONCILIATION, identificando qué capacidades existen realmente, cuáles están parciales, cuáles son solo diseño y cuáles faltan. Incluir People Core, Workforce, asistencia/jornada, incidencias, prenómina/nómina, ISR/CFDI, IMSS/SBC/SDI/SUA/SIPARE/glosas/confrontas, altas/bajas/modificaciones salariales, INFONAVIT, FONACOT, ISN estatal, previsión social, sindicatos/CCT, STPS/NOM/seguridad y salud, conciliaciones, dispersión, contabilidad, finiquitos/liquidaciones, protección de datos, multi-país/multi-jurisdicción y versionado temporal de reglas. No rediseñar ni implementar; mapear el AS-IS y preservar estructuras canónicas.

queries.name: rh_hcm_candidate_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V','P','FN','IF','TF') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rh%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%emple%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%persona%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%nomina%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%payroll%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%vacant%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%reclut%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%contrat%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%expedient%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%turno%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%horario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%asisten%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%incidenc%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%vacacion%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%incap%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%imss%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%infonavit%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%fonacot%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%sua%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%sipare%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%glosa%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%confront%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%finiquit%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%liquid%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%sindicat%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%capacit%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%seguridad%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%riesgo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%concili%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name;

queries.name: rh_hcm_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%rh%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%emple%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%persona%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%nomina%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%payroll%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%vacant%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%reclut%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%contrat%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%expedient%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%asisten%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%incidenc%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%imss%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%infonavit%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%fonacot%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%sua%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%sipare%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%glosa%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%concili%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id;

queries.name: rh_hcm_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT s1.name AS schema_name, t1.name AS table_name, fk.name AS fk_name, c1.name AS column_name, s2.name AS ref_schema_name, t2.name AS ref_table_name, c2.name AS ref_column_name FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables t1 ON t1.object_id=fk.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s1 ON s1.schema_id=t1.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c1 ON c1.object_id=t1.object_id AND c1.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables t2 ON t2.object_id=fk.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s2 ON s2.schema_id=t2.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c2 ON c2.object_id=t2.object_id AND c2.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE LOWER(t1.name) LIKE '%rh%' OR LOWER(t1.name) LIKE '%emple%' OR LOWER(t1.name) LIKE '%persona%' OR LOWER(t1.name) LIKE '%nomina%' OR LOWER(t1.name) LIKE '%payroll%' OR LOWER(t1.name) LIKE '%asisten%' OR LOWER(t1.name) LIKE '%incidenc%' OR LOWER(t1.name) LIKE '%imss%' OR LOWER(t1.name) LIKE '%infonavit%' OR LOWER(t1.name) LIKE '%fonacot%' ORDER BY s1.name,t1.name,fk.name;

queries.name: rh_hcm_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.is_unique, i.is_primary_key, c.name AS column_name, ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=t.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.name IS NOT NULL AND (LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%rh%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%emple%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%persona%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%nomina%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%payroll%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%asisten%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%incidenc%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%imss%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%infonavit%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%fonacot%') ORDER BY s.name,t.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal;
